function.name: extract_pdf_text
function.description: Extracts text, metadata, page-by-page breakdown, and OCR content from PDF URLs using the Apify PDF Text Extractor.

urls.description: List of direct PDF URLs, Google Drive / Dropbox share links, or arXiv abstract URLs to process.

ocrMode.description: Auto runs OCR on scanned pages without text layer. Off skips OCR.

chunkSize.description: Optional character chunk size for RAG retrieval.
